settings.title: Settings
settings.launchOnStartupDesc: Start the companion app when Windows boots
settings.openDashboardDesc: Show this window when the app starts
settings.alwaysAdminDesc: Required for overlays on games running as admin
settings.closeAction.askDesc: Show a dialog asking what to do when you close a window.
settings.closeAction.closeWindowDesc: Close the window. The app keeps running in the background.
settings.closeAction.exitDesc: Quit the entire app when you close a window.
settings.languageDesc: Changes the language for the companion app interface
settings.infoNote: Game-specific auto-run settings can be configured on each game's page in the sidebar. App settings like hotkeys can be configured in the overlay or desktop windows.
settings.gpu.defaultDesc: Full GPU acceleration. Best performance for interactive maps.
settings.gpu.disableVideoDesc: Only disables DirectComposition for video content. Try this first if you experience screen flickering.
settings.gpu.disableCompositingDesc: Disables GPU-based compositing. May help with multi-monitor flickering issues.
settings.gpu.softwareDesc: Completely disables GPU. Slowest option, use only as a last resort.
settings.gpuWarning: Non-default GPU settings may reduce map performance. Only use if experiencing display issues.
home.discordJoin: Join the {{discord}} to share your own suggestions!
game.overlayHint: Start the game to enable the overlay. Desktop mode is always available.
game.driverBlockedHint: The game is running, but the companion app cannot track it until the driver problem shown at the top is fixed.
game.exclusiveFullscreenWarning: The game is running in Exclusive Fullscreen — the overlay can flicker, disappear, or ignore clicks. Switch the game's display mode to Borderless or Windowed Fullscreen for a stable overlay.
game.webOnlyHint: This game only has web-based maps available. Companion app support with overlays and position tracking is not available yet.
game.autoRunDesc: Automatically launch companion when game starts
game.noSessions: No sessions recorded yet. Start the game to see session activity.
elevation.title: Administrator Required
elevation.subtitle: For overlay on {{gameName}}
elevation.description: This game is running with elevated privileges. Windows security prevents the overlay from displaying above it without matching permissions.
elevation.hint: Restarting as administrator will allow the overlay to work properly.
driver.banner.blocked: {{game}} is running but cannot be tracked.
driver.bridgeNotInstalled.title: Driver service is not installed
driver.bridgeNotInstalled.description: The THGL Bridge Host service is missing, so games cannot be detected. Repairing the installation registers it again.
driver.bridgeNotRunning.title: Driver service is stopped
driver.bridgeNotRunning.description: The THGL Bridge Host service is installed but not running. Starting it usually fixes game detection right away.
driver.bridgeNoResponse.title: Driver service is not responding
driver.bridgeNoResponse.description: The THGL Bridge Host service accepted the connection but did not answer. Restarting the driver service usually fixes it.
driver.bridgeBusy.title: Driver service is busy
driver.bridgeBusy.description: The THGL Bridge Host service is busy. This usually resolves itself within a few seconds.
driver.clientNotAuthorized.title: App signature rejected by the driver service
driver.clientNotAuthorized.description: The THGL Bridge Host service refused this app's code signature. This happens when Windows is missing the Certum root certificate the app is signed with. Repairing the installation updates the service to a version that handles this on its own.
driver.driverNotRunning.title: Kernel driver is not running
driver.driverNotRunning.description: The THGL driver is not running. Restarting the driver service reloads it. If that does not help, repair the installation or check whether security software blocks the driver.
driver.deviceAccessDenied.title: Driver refused this app
driver.deviceAccessDenied.description: The THGL driver is running but did not accept this app. Repairing the installation usually fixes it.
driver.error.title: Driver error
driver.error.description: The driver reported an unexpected error ({{code}}). Repairing the installation usually fixes it.
driver.ok.title: Driver ready
driver.repair.needsAdmin: Windows will ask for administrator permission.
driver.sendSnapshot: Still not working? Send a debug snapshot from the menu (bug icon). It now includes the driver service log.
settings.relaunchNormalBlocked: Turn off "Always run as administrator" first
settings.relaunchDesc: Restarts the app with the other privilege level. Open map windows close.
settings.compatFlagRemoved: This session was started through Windows Compatibility "Run as administrator", which is not supported. The setting was removed. Restart the app to run it normally.
settings.compatFlagPresent: Windows Compatibility "Run as administrator" is set for the app and is not supported. Uncheck it under Properties > Compatibility and restart the app.
